g.text: Solid arrow: reference Dashed arrow: dependency Filled diamond: ownership Hollow triangle: interface
All seven top-level UI types are shown. GameSetupPanel, CreditsPanel and GamePanel extend JPanel.
Nested decorative/layout classes and inherited Swing members are omitted for readability.
UnoApplication also uses HomeText/UiTheme and creates GameEngine; CardStyle uses UiTheme.
Callbacks are method references, not retained UnoApplication fields inside the panels.
